description: Perú: Connection Routes in Cusco is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Hub Latin America. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-04-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
